summary: network_cli retries connections 3 times by default with exponentially growing delay until attempts or timeouts run out; raise with network_cli_retries in [persistent_connection].
questions: How do I make network_cli retry connecting more times?
What's the default number of network_cli connection retries?

answer_card.title: Increase network_cli retries
answer_card.answer_md:
Default is 3 attempts, with the delay doubling each retry until attempts run out or `persistent_command_timeout`/`persistent_connect_timeout` triggers.
```ini
[persistent_connection]
network_cli_retries = 5
```
